channel.title: Album
channel.description: Following are accounts of a few of the weddings I have been honored to officiate.

item.title: Ashley and Adam - Cielo at Castle Pines
item.description: Paul Anderson was our officiant 09/20/2015 and working with him was a fantastic experience! He was extremely helpful as we were trying to put together the perfect ceremony and made great suggestions to make the script perfect. Both during the rehearsal and the actual ceremony he helped everything flow smoothly and was incredibly professional. He made our day even more special and we are both so thankful we picked him to be our officiant!!

item.title: John and Sharon - Garden of the Gods Club
item.description: Our wedding at the Garden of the Gods Club was perfect. After our first meeting with you, Sharon and I knew we were in good hands. Your flexibility and advice during the setting up the ceremony and creating our vows took a lot of stress off our plate and contributed to such a great day. I would like to say thank you for all your effort and advice, and helping in creating what was a perfect day for Sharon and I.

item.title: Celeste and Ernest - Cielo at Castle Pines
item.description: We are so glad that we chose Paul as our officiant. He made the entire process run smoothly and took the stress off of writing out the wedding ceremony. We were even able to add in a bit of our own unique style and humor in the script! Both of us would highly recommend Paul to anyone looking for a wedding officiant!

item.title: Marianne and Kjell - The Cliff House
item.description: Our experience with Paul Anderson was fantastic. We were not exactly sure what we wanted to do for the ceremony and he made it simple and easy. He helped us organize and made himself available to answer questions and meet as many times as we wanted. I would highly recommend him to any of my friends.

item.title: Jason and Nicole - The Pinery
item.description: I just want to thank you from the bottom of my heart for the wonderful job you did officiating our wedding this past weekend. You offered the calming presence we needed. Your optimistic approach and genuine enthusiasm helped make our special day a joyous one to remember. So many family and friends commented on how awesome you are! I’m considering exchanging my ring for a white gold version. If you don’t mind, will you please send up a blessing for whichever ring I choose? Thank you so very much!

item.title: Robert and Clare - Villa Parker - Parker, CO
item.description: Paul was wonderful to work with! The whole process was very easy and fun. He offered support throughout the planning and gave us many vow options to choose from along with writing our own. Our big day went perfectly and the ceremony was flawless and beautiful!

item.title: Karen and Alex - Castle Pines
item.description: We would like to express our sincere gratitude to Paul for doing a such wonderful job officiating our wedding. From our first meeting, he listened to our every hope for our ceremony and worked closely with us in putting all the pieces together. He was always quick to respond to any questions that came up during the planning and was an excellent resource for ideas and suggestions to make our day special for us and our guests. He was professional, courteous and truly cared about us and the happenings in our lives. We felt and still feel we can turn to him for help with anything that may come up and would happily recommend him as an officiant to friends and family. Thank you, Paul for being a genuine friend and for sharing our day with us!

item.title: Claire and Pete - Cheyenne Mountain Resort
item.description: Thank you for bringing your guidance and wisdom to our wedding and our marriage. Your encouragement to focus on our vows helped us to have many important - though not always easy - conversations. Thanks you also for bringing a sense of calm and support to the actual day. We loved the ceremony.” Claire and Pete

item.title: Jami and Eric - The Pinery
item.description: Words can’t thank you enough for what a truly amazing job you did conducting our wedding ceremony! We are so grateful that we met you and you were able to give us and share your gift of words and meaningful memories. They will always be in our hearts forever. You did a wonderful job. We couldn’t be happier! Thank You!!!

item.title: Catherine and Matthew - The Craftwood Inn
item.description: Words cannot express the gratitude we have towards you. You were simply flawless in your presentation and were constantly checking in on me throughout the whole wedding planning process. When I had kooky ideas such as my "dove ceremony", you became so excited and created the most amazing, heartfelt, & memorable reading. It was our pleasure to have you a part of the most special day in our lives. Thank you so much!!!!

item.title: Lindsey and Austin - Air Force Academy, Cadet Chapel
item.description: My name is Lindsey Noble. My husband Austin and I were married on July 28th, 2012 by Paul Anderson. Working with Paul was easy and stress-free, which was quite the relief to me because I was planning our Colorado wedding from Illinois. He communicated regularly with me and always responded quickly to my emails or questions. Paul was flexible, professional and easy to work with. He worked with us and made sure that the ceremony was exactly what we wanted. He also brought his warmth and wisdom, which added a personal touch to the ceremony. It felt as if the ceremony was being performed by someone we knew our whole lives. I feel very blessed to have had Paul as our chaplain. He made our day memorable and special.

item.title: Beth and Kirk - The Broadmoor
item.description: We were so pleased with Paul's involvement in our wedding Ceremony at the Broadmoor, as well as with your presence at both our rehearsal dinner and reception. It was almost as if we had known you for years. The community there with us, on our most important day, together, was moved by your words and got our new family off to a great start. We cannot thank you enough. Beth and Kirk

item.title: Christina and Brian - Garden of the Gods Club
item.description: A day we will cherish for the rest of our lives... Paul was more than our ceremony officiant, he was there every step of the way with his support, guidance, and expertise. He was able to lead us towards a stress free day of enjoyment with family and friends! Paul was always available whenever we needed him. He truly made an effort to make our wedding meaningful and personal. I can't imagine the day without him! We are forever grateful for Paul's friendship and for being part of our special day! With love, Christina & Brian

item.title: Jamie and Nick - Cielo at Castle Pines
item.description: I can honestly say that because of Chaplain Paul Anderson, and a few kind hearted and wonderful people like him, May 18, 2012 was a dream come true! My husband Nick and I were first married at a courthouse on February 26, 2004 just 4 days before he deployed to Iraq. We made plans to have a wedding when he returned. That changed when he was severely injured 2 months later and was medically retired from the U.S. Army. Our priorities changed and we put our wedding on the back burner. In 2011 some friends decided to change that, they called Cielo at Castle Pines and asked if they would be willing to help put together a wedding for us. They immediately said yes and the planning began. I was told in January to pick a date. The first time I met with Roz at Cielo she told me if we wanted someone to officiate she knew the perfect guy for the job. At first we weren’t sure since we were already legally married, we didn’t need anyone official. We decided to call and meet him before we made a decision. The first time we talked to him we knew we had to have him officiate our ceremony. He was the perfect guy for our wedding! He helped us write a ceremony that was just right for us. As crazy (wonderful) as that day was for me one of the nicest memories was when Chaplain Paul walked up to me with a hanger full of ties and asked which one I wanted him to wear. It showed how much he truly cared about making this day perfect for me. Thank you Paul for making our wedding so truly beautiful and for letting us meet your beautiful wife. Nick and I are blessed to have such wonderful people in our lives.
